name: ps-vita-porter
description: Skills, the vita CLI and a shared knowledge base for porting full-source C/C++ games to PS Vita with AI agents.

plugins.name: ps-vita-porter
plugins.description: Port a C/C++ game whose full source you have (typically a universal-decompiler reconstruction) to PS Vita as a .vpk with an AI agent: project scan, intake questions with recommendations, VitaSDK builds (native or Docker), LiveArea assets, .vpk checks, asset conversion, a PC Vita-simulation profile, Vita3K runs, deployment and logs over vitacompanion, a publish guard and a shared knowledge base.
